integrity: One self-contained proof and a standard-library original-identity finite-field checker are provided. Finite checks corroborate, but do not certify, the theorem. Historical priority and independent validation remain unconfirmed.
limitations: The result is for derivations of a parallel-arrow, two-vertex path algebra in positive characteristic and D raised to the characteristic power equal to zero. It does not cover arbitrary nilpotency degrees, general quivers, or orbit closures.
title: Automorphism orbits and rank spectra of nilpotent derivations of Kronecker path algebras
